dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors to the park and members of Indian tribes seeking access to traditional cultural and religious sites.
dimensions.evidence: provide access to those sites by members of Indian tribes for traditional cultural and customary uses.

dimensions.assessment: Changes the administrative designation from monument to park and formalizes tribal consultation and access rights.
dimensions.evidence: redesignates the Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as the Chiricahua National Park.

dimensions.assessment: Existing funds for the monument remain available for the park; no new spending figures are provided.
dimensions.evidence: Any funds available for the Chiricahua National Monument shall be available for the National Park.

dimensions.assessment: Alters the statutory designation and adds explicit provisions for tribal site protection and temporary area closures.
dimensions.evidence: establish the Chiricahua National Park in the State of Arizona as a unit of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Permanent redesignation and ongoing administrative requirement for the National Park System.
dimensions.evidence: establish the Chiricahua National Park in the State of Arizona as a unit of the National Park System

missing_information: Any new funding amounts required for the park designation.
importance_detail.rationale: Redesignates the Chiricahua National Monument as a National Park and establishes specific requirements for protecting traditional cultural sites and providing tribal access, with temporary closures possible.
